title: From a recorded trace to a faster interaction
purpose: Learn the order of steps that finds a long task in a trace and checks that a fix brings INP under 200 ms.
explanation: Throttle the CPU, record a trace while you click, and read the Main track. A task over 50 ms is a long task. If the interaction takes over 200 ms, split the work so the page can paint first, then record again.
alt: Flowchart: set CPU throttling, record and click, read the Main track flame chart, decide if a task is over 50 ms; if yes it is a long task, the interaction over 200 ms is flagged, split the work and record again until INP is at or under 200 ms; if no, check the Layout shifts track for CLS at or under 0.1.

learning_check.question: Which part of a 300 ms task does the Performance panel shade red?
learning_check.answer: The last 250 ms, the part over 50 ms.
